outcome.summary:
Conditional on Kantor (1987, which depends on the classification of finite simple groups), the Thas–Zagier special-prime/base-two reduction together with their imported n<2·10^11 search, and Feit's valid 8|n and divisor-multiplier conditions (which give n≡8 mod 24):

One C production run reports that every n≡8 (mod 24) in [2·10^11, 10341223092224) either has p=n²+n+1 with a proper factor ≤10^6 or has 2^(n+1)≢1 (mod p), with no survivors. That run was not replayed in review because its logs were missing from the snapshot. If confirmed, this gives the conditional bound n<10341223092224 for non-Desarguesian flag-transitive planes. The bound would rest on that single computation plus sampled checks; a separate Python scan, also unreplayed, reports [2·10^11, 439679307776).

Verified by replay h
